The paper uses a developed diffusion model to investigate the propagation of ALD film growth in narrow lateral channels.
The model incorporates low-pressure gas transport, Langmuir adsorption dynamics, and channel narrowing caused by film deposition.
Fitting an analytical approximate diffusion solution to measured thickness profiles extracts the adsorption equilibrium constant and sticking coefficient.
The diffusion simulations accurately predict experimental thickness profiles for both Al2O3 and TiO2 ALD processes.
